notes: House sorting, a dorm room you upgrade, and eggs that hatch a partner animal are open-ended school life rather than a job loop, so this leads with Roleplay & Avatar Sim; Simulation is named second because the classes are repeatable activity stations and only its trigger-task expresses a potion bench or a broom-flying launch, which no Roleplay row covers. Shape is settlement-claimable because the author's answer makes the upgradeable room a pre-built dorm inside an assigned house quarter — claimed and customized, never constructed — which rules out settlement-buildable, and settlement-static is ruled out by the personal room existing at all. Took the Pet Care preset whole for its egg-and-pet loop and its campus-shaped options: building-interior for the classrooms and dorms, social-hub for the one central courtyard the author asked for, path-street for the walkways linking it to each building; added district-zoned so the three houses read as physically distinct colour-coded quarters, and left path-road-vehicle out since a compact walking campus needs no car streets. Decided without a user that the three house names, colours and emblems are the build's to invent as the author asked, and that broom flying is a play-height envelope over the grounds rather than a self-occluding volume, so it raises no CHECK; P3 is real and unavoidable here because players go inside classrooms and their own dorm.
